title: Rear Admiral Gallaudet researching underwater anomalies

tellings.quote: I know Rear Admiral Tim Galidet uh who used to run uh Noah National Oceanic and Atmospheric Association is highly interested in these underwater anomalies.

plain: A retired Navy rear admiral named Tim Galidet, who once ran the US government agency that studies the oceans and weather, is keenly interested in strange objects seen underwater. Ryan Graves, a former Navy fighter pilot, says this from knowing him, describing Galidet as the man "who used to run uh Noah National Oceanic and Atmospheric Association" and is "highly interested in these underwater anomalies." Graves brings it up to show that senior people take objects in the sea seriously.
